senses.gloss: m. (מְצַר I, v. מִצְרִי I) rope of rushes &c.;

units: B. Bath. 127ᵇ דקארי ליה עבדא מ׳ מאה when he had been in the habit of calling him (whom he now claims to be his son) promiscuously ‘slave’, ‘metsar (rope)’, ‘one hundred’); מאי מ׳ מאה מ׳ עבדא מאה [דשוה] מאה זוזי (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 70) what is metsar meah? M. means slave; meah, that he is worth one hundred Zuz; [differ. interpret. in comment.—Alf. דאמרי אינשי מ׳ עבדא מאה זוזי for people say, ‘the rope of a slave (is worth) one hundred Zuz’].

senses.gloss: a cable stretched across a river and holding a board suspended, rope-bridge.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 167a:7">B. Bath. 167ᵃ</cite> <he>אנחי ידאי אמ׳</he> I would put my hand on a rope-bridge (and write to imitate the writing of a trembling hand).
